messages:
zoe: Heads-up: hitting a parity/param drift between starter-kit-python (sdk v1.2.0) and direct REST for embeddings. The app gets different vectors for identical text depending on client used.

zoe: Repro:
1) starter-kit-python: `client.embeddings.create(input=\"hello world\")` -> model used: `redwood-embed-1` by default
2) curl REST: `model=\"embed-redwood-1\"` in payload -> different output/hash

zoe: SDK snippet (what starter-kit sends):
```py
payload = {
  "input": "hello world",
  "model": "redwood-embed-1",
  "normalize": True,
  "extra": None
}
# SDK serializes by dropping None keys
```

rafael: Interesting. REST expects model id `embed-redwood-1` (historic name) and treats normalize as string \"true\" for backward compat. SDK normalizes types and drops nulls -> small semantic diff.

priya: Where do we see the discrepancy? Is it only naming or also type coercion?

zoe: Both. Gateway log shows mapping layer: when `model` key is `redwood-embed-1` we route to quantized variant, different embedding weights. Also if `normalize` is boolean true it triggers an L2 postproc path in runtime; if it's string \"true\" it goes through compatibility shim. Net effect: two code paths, small but noticeable cosine-diff.

ops-bot: Alert: multiple onboarding runs failed similarity tests this morning (starter-kit-python). Count=6, window=2h.

rafael: Okay we need to standardize: SDK should use canonical model id (`embed-redwood-1`) and preserve legacy stringy flags unless param documented as strict.

priya: Proposal: 1) map legacy aliases in SDK input layer (accept redwood-embed-1 -> embed-redwood-1) 2) keep optional params as-is (don't coerce booleans to native types for fields historically treated as strings) 3) add conformance tests to sample app test harness.

zoe: Quick workaround for starters: set model explicitly in starter-kit config to `embed-redwood-1` and pass `normalize: \"true\"` as string. Add a comment in README explaining the mismatch.

rafael: I'll open a tiny compatibility shim in SDK that normalizes model aliases and preserves string-typed legacy flags. We'll add unit tests and an e2e against the integration gateway that has routing parity.

priya: Also audit other SDKs (node, go) for the same alias problem. This likely caused a few support tickets last month where outputs "didn't match REST".

zoe: Filed issue #4180 (embeddings param alias + type drift). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/102. Patch includes mapping table and two tests.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch fix/embeddings-alias: build 2026.03.23.89. Running unit + conformance tests.

rafael: If CI passes, nominate for v1.2.1 patch. Also add a telemetry counter that records when SDK sends an alias vs canonical id so we can measure adoption and roll out changes safely.

priya: And add a short note to the onboarding checklist: "If embeddings differ between SDK and REST, explicitly set model id to embed-redwood-1 and pass legacy flags as documented."

zoe: Thanks — will update starter-kit PR and docs after SDK PR merges. Closing loop once staging tests green. :+1:
